verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server (developer.paypal.com/ai-tools/mcp-server) letting merchants use natural language with MCP clients, plus a broader agent toolkit that explicitly lists MCP as a supported integration alongside LangChain, CrewAI, etc., backed by a public GitHub repo. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the MCP server working end-to-end, and clearer scoping of which tools/APIs are exposed specifically via the MCP server versus the general agent toolkit.
